/Lotus/Powersuits/Geode/CitrinePrime.passiveDescription: Citrine grants nearby allies |BASE| health regeneration per second. Pick up a Health Orb to increase regeneration by |HPS|, up to a maximum of |MAX|.

Eris, carved up and presented to Praghasa in bite sized chunks.

Obtained from Infested nodes on Eris during Epoch Operation: Taubound.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/EntropicKuvaRes:
A dangerous and erratic type of Kuva.

Obtained from Zariman missions.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/CapturaScenes/Photobooth: Unlocks this scene for use in Captura Mode, accessed through the Warframe Appearance tab in the Arsenal.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/RivenSplicerDes: Used in the Mod Workbench to splice Riven traits into a new trait  from a special pool of possibilities.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/NarinPoemDesc: An ancient piece of parchment in the Tethyan style.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyBa: Change of plans: leave nothing uncuddled with this adorable floof.
This unusual floof was likely the result of a manufacturing error. Will you accept it into your home, Tenno?
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVa: Valkyr could probably use a hug too, and this squishy floof means it's perfectly safe!
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/PlushyVo: Embrace the wolf with this cuddly floof.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Movember: A Movember Frame Display of the Master Moustache, created by Community artist Veroz.

A Movember Frame Display of the Tusker Moustache, created by Community artist Veroz.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/QTCC2Cat: A unique display created for Princess Margaret Cancer Foundation Quest 2026.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Primes/ChromaPrimeCrysta: A gleaming reminder of Citrine Prime to decorate your Orbiter.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/LisetPro: A recreation of Narin's icy crest and rapier, forever entombed aboard your Orbiter.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/ShipDecorations/Conquera: A display featuring Voruna playing with a Kubrow, and Valkyr fishing with a Kavat in Duviri. Created by Community Artist Studio Cyen.
A display featuring Valkyr, Kalymos and loyal Kavat Companions. Created by Community Artist GroovyTaxi.
A display featuring Voruna and loyal Kubrow Companions. Created by Community Artist GroovyTaxi.

A Movember Display of Sirius and Orion, created by Community artist Veroz.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Fragments/DevourerSongDe: A Requiem for an Infested moon to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Fragments/IceSpeakerSong: Iceblade of Narin music to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Fragments/NeotesDanceSon: Iceblade of Narin music to enjoy from the Somachord in your Orbiter.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Primes/CraftingComponent: Chassis component of the Citrine Prime Warframe.
Neuroptics component of the Citrine Prime Warframe.
Systems component of the Citrine Prime Warframe.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/WarframeCrafting/Craftin: Chassis component of the Narin Warframe.
Neuroptics component of the Narin Warframe.
Systems component of the Narin Warframe.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Primes/CitrinePrimeDesc: The crystalline citadel ascends. Citrine Prime captivates with refined radiance, her brilliant gems set within the finest gold filigree.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShardsAbility: Slash and stagger enemies with a crystal blast that inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Enemies afflicted with this Status Effect have an increased chance of dropping Health and Energy Orbs.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeShellAbilityD: Citrine guards herself and nearby allies with a crystalline shell that gradually decays. Kills and assists increase the defensive power of the shell.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeCrystalAbilit: Deploy a gem that shoots prismatic beams. The gem targets enemies that are taking weapon damage from Citrine and her allies. Its beams inflict Heat, Cold, Toxin, and Electricity Status Effects. Status Chance and Status Duration increase for nearby allies.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Suits/GeodeGrowthsAbilit: Citrine summons crystal fractals. The fractals rush forward, seeking enemies. Enemies touched by the fractals are paralyzed by crystalline growths. Hit the growths to deal Critical Damage.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistSuitDesc: Narin descends in swirling eddies, her blade keen and deadly as an icy wind. She wields ice to defend as deftly as her swift rapier strikes.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityT:
Lunge with Narin's ice rapier Neote, inflicting <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage and <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold and <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR> Puncture Status Effect on foes directly ahead of her.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityR:
Recover Shields by absorbing <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Status Effect from nearby enemies. Gain <OVERGUARD_GAIN> Overguard if at full Shields.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityL:
Tap to leap into the air, tap again to land at target location. Applies <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage Vulnerability and Status Effect in a large radius upon landing.

Gain Ice for each enemy hit.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistAbilityB: Requires full Ice to cast. An ancestral spirit descends upon Narin and she begins sword dancing for continuous nearby damage. Press Attack to launch shattering icy slashes that deplete Armor and Shields. Hitting Frozen enemies causes them to explode, dealing massive radial <DT_FREEZE_COLOR> Cold Damage. Attacks on Marked Targets cost no Ice and do more damage.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistPistolsD: Narin's signature pistols strike with winter's bite. Reloading sends out a chilling pulse that inflicts Cold Status Effect, the pulse's range increases with each round reloaded.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeSteflosShotg: This rose has gilded thorns. Deal death from even further afar with Citrine Prime's signature shotgun.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Iceblade/DuelistBowDesc: Narin's signature bow is the north wind's icy messenger. Alt Fire unleashes a charged blizzard arrow that freezes enemies it touches and leaves behind a chilling path.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/Primes/PrimeCorufellDesc: Corufell Prime's golden vines streamline its transformation for even faster Heavy Attacks.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/QuestPartADe: Find the Lotus in the Dark Refractory and seek her out within her memories.
dictionary./Lotus/Language/TauPrologue/QuestPartBDe: The Vessel has awoken. Praghasa has returned. Deploy to the surface of Eris... fuel is required.
